english.title: Administer botulinum toxin or filler for cosmetic purpose to person under 18
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) administered

(A)_[botulinum toxin]_
(B)_[a subcutaneous, submucous or intradermal injection of a filler for a cosmetic purpose]_

to **(..SPECIFY PERSON TO WHOM SUBSTANCE ADMINISTERED..), a person under the age of 18
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (6) of the Botulinum Toxin and Cosmetic Fillers (Children) Act 2021.
